rules.title: Authenticate connections
rules.text: Authenticate on connect and authorize each subscription or message.

rules.title: Reconnect with backoff
rules.text: Reconnect with exponential backoff and resync state after reconnecting.

rules.title: Heartbeats
rules.text: Send heartbeats and close dead connections.

rules.title: Handle backpressure
rules.text: Bound per-connection queues and drop or disconnect slow consumers.

rules.title: Versioned messages
rules.text: Define a typed, versioned message schema.

rules.title: Validate Origin
rules.text: Check the Origin header on the handshake to prevent cross-site WebSocket hijacking, and do not rely on cookies alone for authorization.

rules.title: Use wss
rules.text: Use wss:// (TLS) for every WebSocket connection outside localhost.
